title: The master names its own dsh tag from the running container when tracy-host cannot read host-dsh.env, so shard heartbeats are no longer held at TAG_UNKNOWN
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd`. The test hands masterTags the answer a real master's tracy-host gives (image.tag null, container.image = ghcr.io/tracyhq/tracy-dsh:<tag>). Tests that need TEST_DATABASE_URL skip; none of them is named here.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
dshTagOf returns the container's tag for the tracy-dsh repository, keeps image.tag when present, and returns null for another repository or a digest.
fence: No server, no network, no database: hostCall is a local double returning the measured answer shape.

tests: the master s dsh tag falls back to the running container when the host cannot read host-dsh.env
the master s tags: app from its env, dsh from its own host, asked once per ten minutes, the last good kept
